facts.fact: The BDIH programme page says the SmartBots Digital Transformation Strategy was adopted by the Government of Botswana in 2020.

BWA.note: Digital Services Act is said only to set up an authority and give public bodies a window to name a data contact and hold a position on release and reuse; no data-sharing duty or in-force date stated.

facts.fact: The BDIH page says Botswana is actively shaping its own Open Data Policy through the National Open Data Forum process and that the work is not yet finished.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Innovation (Open Data Technical Working Group)

BWA.note: Page describes a hackathon on open government data; it names no portal or datasets published for download and no licence.
No startup law, strategy, labelling or fund stated.

facts.fact: Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub is open and runs the Open Data Innovation Challenge programme, with three ventures from Phase 1 reported in pre-incubation; no incubation cohort programme is described.
